turn_boundaries.speaker: host_1
turn_boundaries.text: Welcome to Topic 1: Laws of Reflection. We begin with the First Law of Reflection. Notice how the normal line divides the incident and reflected rays into two strictly identical angles.

turn_boundaries.speaker: host_2
turn_boundaries.text: Dr. Sarah, looking at the formula \angle i = \angle r, what's the key thing students usually trip over here?

turn_boundaries.speaker: host_1
turn_boundaries.text: Great question, Alex. The big takeaway is: Reflection is completely symmetrical with respect to the perpendicular normal.
